headline: A 2008 order by President Bush settled legal claims by Americans against the government of Libya.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order dealt with the settlement of claims against Libya. It likely closed out legal claims that Americans had against the Libyan government. No official summary was provided, so details about the terms, the amounts, or how claims were handled cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Americans with legal claims against the government of Libya
who_it_affects.how: Their claims were addressed through a government-level settlement instead of being handled separately.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 31, 2008; no separate effective date was provided.
